units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣要把六女公子许配匂亲王，匂亲王不答应。

en.t: Yugiri, the Left Minister, wanted to marry his sixth daughter to Prince Niou, but Prince Niou would not agree.

units.source_text: 现经双方议决，强迫他娶。

en.t: Now that both sides had settled the matter, they were forcing him to take her as his wife.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言闻之，甚是着急，然而无可如何。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard this and was terribly anxious, but there was nothing he could do.

units.source_text: 他独自寻思：“我这个人实在太古怪了。

en.t: Alone, he thought to himself, "I really am an exceedingly strange person.

units.source_text: 大约由于前世宿缘，我始终不忘记八亲王生前挂念两女公子时的苦情。

en.t: Perhaps because of a bond from a former life, I have never been able to forget the anguish Prince Hachi felt in his lifetime when he worried over his two daughters.

units.source_text: 又见两女公子貌美而命薄，可惜她们埋没一生，希望她们生涯幸福，便异常热心地加以照拂。

en.t: Seeing, too, that the two young ladies were beautiful yet ill fated, I pitied the thought of their lives being wasted in obscurity and, wishing them happiness, cared for them with unusual devotion.

units.source_text: 适逢匂亲王钟情于她们，异常恳切地要求我玉成其事。

en.t: Just then Prince Niou fell in love with them and, with extraordinary earnestness, asked me to help bring the match about.

units.source_text: 我所爱的不是二女公子，而是大女公子。

en.t: The one I loved was not the younger daughter, but the elder one.

units.source_text: 大女公子要把二女公子让给我，非我所愿。

en.t: The elder daughter meant to yield the younger one to me, but that was not what I wished.

units.source_text: 我就把二女公子介绍给了匂亲王。

en.t: So I introduced the younger daughter to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 如今回想起来，好不后悔！

en.t: When I think back on it now, how bitterly I regret it!

units.source_text: 其实我兼得了两女公子，也不会有人怪我。

en.t: In truth, even if I had taken both young ladies for myself, no one would have blamed me.

units.source_text: 现已无法挽回，然而痛悔失策。”

en.t: Now it can no longer be undone, yet I grieve bitterly over my mistaken course."

units.source_text: 匂亲王则更加痛苦，他无时不想念二女公子，恋恋地关怀宇治山庄。

en.t: Prince Niou, for his part, suffered even more; not for a moment did he cease thinking of the younger daughter, and he longingly kept Uji Villa in his heart.

units.source_text: 明石皇后常常对他说：“你倘有中意的人，就叫她到这里来，一定让她同别人一样享福。

en.t: Empress Akashi often said to him, "If there is someone you favor, have her come here, and I will surely let her enjoy happiness just like the others.
His Majesty shows you special concern.

units.source_text: 而你行为轻率，惹起世人讥议，我很替你惋惜。”

en.t: Yet your conduct is rash and has provoked the criticism of the world; I feel deeply sorry for your sake."
